## Specialization
Ritesh Batra's positioning is decision-first, data-driven real estate guidance without sales pressure. His approach is to compare price, carrying costs, neighbourhood fit, property condition, resale implications, negotiation risk and alternatives before a client commits. Client feedback repeatedly highlights patience, clear explanations, pros and cons, market knowledge, responsiveness and attention to detail.
